pages.title: Ancient Yunlai Swordmanship
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r While held: +5.0 attack speed, +5.0 blocks attack range, melee damage ×1.50. On hit: 75% chance to unleash a 10-block sword qi along your line of sight, dealing 75% of the hit's damage.$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Yunlai Swordmanship and other melee damage/growth enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Loot chests only, as enchanted books (treasure; no enchanting table or villager trades)
